svg.title: Capture Changes and Update Table
svg.desc: The tour starts with a compatible source and high capture, changes and low with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure GoldenGate. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Object Storage operates as a temporary area. the JDBC connection to Spark from Oracle AI Data Platform participates in stage-and-merge. Check that the destination table reflects the intended changes with permissions and connections set for each tranche.

text.tspan: Temporary area → JDBC connection → Spark stage-and-merge
Check changes at destination and validate permissions by tranche.
